requirements.title: Current code mapping, audit baseline, test harness
Semantic indicator registry, dataset licensing, immutable catalog
Official reference acquisition and verified cache
Multi-provider AI gateway with Ollama
requirements.notes: Unified gateway exercised against live Groq/NVIDIA endpoints and a local Ollama daemon: structured-output capability probe, real-404 provider failover, real-401 credential failover to the second configured key, local-only routing with every cloud key present, and secret redaction. 11 configured credentials verified live (evidence: evidence/provider_credentials.json, evidence/live_providers.json). Live tests skip and the workstream stays unverified where credentials or the local daemon are absent.

requirements.title: Research agent planner and hypothesis registry
requirements.notes: Bounded roles with read-only tool allowlists, step/token/time/cost/repair budgets, typed hypothesis/claim proposals, injection quarantine and durable hashed audit implemented in engine/ireme/agents.py. Live models and human promotion pending.

requirements.title: Decomposition, causal, predictive and spatial lab
Intervention research/evaluation and programme boundary
requirements.notes: Evidence grading, cost provenance, equity/exclusion, preregistration, abstention and dissemination control exist in engine/ireme/policy.py. MonitoringPlan now requires sourced baselines, comparison strategy, evaluation date and success criteria before consider_scale.

requirements.title: Production secure API, durable workflow, data store
All-district / national acceptance and continuous validation

blockers.title: Official NISR reference artefacts and permissions
blockers.detail: NISR Terms of Use (https://statistics.gov.rw/terms-use) and Hackathon page (https://statistics.gov.rw/about/hackathon) explicitly state: 'Unless otherwise indicated, data and analysis by the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR) is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.' This covers all published PDF reports (EICV7 Poverty Profile, Main Indicators, Methodological Notes) and XLSX tables (EICV7_Tables_Rwanda_Poverty_Profile.xlsx) which include Table A9.23. CC BY 4.0 permits copying, distribution, adaptation, and commercial use with attribution. Evidence artefacts updated with source_licence metadata: eicv7_vs_nisr_table_a9_23.json, python_r_eicv7_comparison.json, governed_science_workflow.json, r_reference_eicv7.json. Anonymized EICV7 microdata (v1) available via NADA portal with registration; published tables derived from it are CC BY 4.0.
